LanguageData.APM_Weapon_DominusMechlance.label: Dominus mechlance
LanguageData.APM_Weapon_DominusMechlance.description: This weapon is imbued with sharpness maintaining mechanites similar to those seen in imperial monotech. Such a technology being utilized by the mechhive allows the hive to apply it on larger and more complex applications, such as this deadly weapon.
LanguageData.APM_Weapon_DominusApexMechlance.label: Dominus apex mechlance
LanguageData.APM_Weapon_DominusApexMechlance.descript: This weapon is imbued with sharpness maintaining mechanites similar to those seen in imperial monotech. Such a technology being utilized by the mechhive allows the hive to apply it on larger and more complex applications, such as this deadly weapon. In such close proximity to the Dominus, the mechanites in this mechlance have been influenced by its psychic presence, so much so that it bleeds out in a reddish hue.

LanguageData.APM_Weapon_CelerusApexVoltana.label: celerus apex voltana
LanguageData.APM_Weapon_CelerusApexVoltana.descriptio: This weapon is imbued with sharpness maintaining mechanites similar to those seen in imperial monotech. The blade crackles with a form of electricity so intense that it glows a savage purple, the impossible color a result of the whims of the Celerus.
